LanguageData.SLT.Tut.P1.Title: 1. Slot machine
LanguageData.SLT.Tut.P1.Body:
Twenty house tokens, a lever, and three reels that already know the answer.
The reels carry this planet's valuables - gold, silver, jade, and berries for the optimists. No real silver changes hands: the tokens are the house's, and they go home when you do. This is the one thing in the rec room where skill will not help you.
See how tall the stack gets before the machine wins. The machine always wins.
LanguageData.SLT.Tut.P2.Title: 2. Paytable
LanguageData.SLT.Tut.P2.Body:
A pull costs one token. Three of a kind pays - gold best, berries least - and a pair of gold gets you a consolation.
That is the whole rulebook. Pull.
